note: BLOCKED: its picture layer is real footage, photos and the source document of a real news event (STYLE.md §1: "Real footage, photos and the source document are the ground"). "Last Train Home" is a fictional animated story: no real footage of it exists. Building this style on our own animated master would mean putting a filter over the original film (the brief forbids it), and fabricating footage that looks real would present a simulation as authentic recording (the brief forbids that too). Not substituted with a generic version.
short: Built on real news footage and documents; the story is fiction, so no real footage of it exists.
